svg.text: SHARING CONTRACT — versioned · signed by both · notarized · one clause per field + direction

text.font-family: Inter, 'SF Pro Display', 'Segoe UI', system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif

svg.text: granularity: exact · banded · aggregate — default opacity, clause-scoped disclosure only

text.font-family: Inter, 'SF Pro Display', 'Segoe UI', system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif

svg.text: cross-party write does not exist as an operation — changes travel as requests a human accepts

text.font-family: Inter, 'SF Pro Display', 'Segoe UI', system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif

svg.text: supplier onboards once — reused by every buyer · light → full migrates nothing

text.font-family: Inter, 'SF Pro Display', 'Segoe UI', system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif

svg.text: agents may read across a boundary, never act · leader agents never talk

text.font-family: Inter, 'SF Pro Display', 'Segoe UI', system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif

svg.text: a node runs fully with the grid unreachable — hub.grid: share, never run

text.font-family: Inter, 'SF Pro Display', 'Segoe UI', system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif
Inter, 'SF Pro Display', 'Segoe UI', system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif

svg.text: hub.notary — Merkle roots to external consensus (Hedera): fair ordering · consensus timestamp · seconds finality

text.font-family: Inter, 'SF Pro Display', 'Segoe UI', system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif

svg.text: tiers: none · local chain · anchored (batched root) · attested (per-event) — hashes salted per tenant

text.font-family: Inter, 'SF Pro Display', 'Segoe UI', system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif

svg.text: submit(topic, root) → receipt · provider swappable · async & queued — a node runs with notary unreachable

text.font-family: Inter, 'SF Pro Display', 'Segoe UI', system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif

svg.text: BENCHMARK NETWORK — GATES ENFORCED IN CODE, NOT POLICY

text.font-family: Inter, 'SF Pro Display', 'Segoe UI', system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif

svg.text: per-metric consent, revocation is retroactive · k-anonymity: k = 5 — count parties, never rows

text.font-family: Inter, 'SF Pro Display', 'Segoe UI', system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif

svg.text: no party above ~1/3 of a sample · publishes p10 / p50 / p90 + party count — never names, never ranks

text.font-family: Inter, 'SF Pro Display', 'Segoe UI', system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif
